value.text: Release attribution corrected to 2026.6.2 after review. The first attribution used the item's last-activity DATE, which is unsound: an item can be touched before the release that finally carried its code. Verified instead by tag containment — git tag --contains 175725a reports 2026.6.2 as the first release holding the implementation commit. Greptile caught this on PR #67 by noticing a historical release predating its implementation.

patch.value: Before this closeout the item had remained in_progress with no activity since its work shipped, so the delivery was missing from the changelog while still being counted as open work in every fleet audit. Closing it with an explicit release attribution is what added the historical entry.
